temporaryGateExclusion.evidence: 0 residuals in the functions or triggers sections. The verifier's exclusion filter (private.flagstone_phase03b_block_row_lifecycle_r2 function; aaa_flagstone_phase03b_row_lifecycle_quiescence_r2 and aaa_flagstone_phase03b_truncate_quiescence_r3 triggers) removed exactly 1 function and 2 triggers before hashing (cardinality-asserted in verify_post_apply.mjs itself), and no other temporary/recovery object leaked into the normalized structure.

rootCause.summary: All 55 residuals are exhaustively explained by 7 tables (bk_2026_08_22_flags, bk_2026_08_22_flag_comments, bk_2026_08_22_flag_edit_history, bk_2026_08_22_flag_photos, bk_2026_08_22_flag_status_history, bk_2026_08_22_flag_verifications, bk_2026_08_22_point_links) and their 48 total columns. Every residual is 'only-in-second' (present in production, absent from the accepted staging baseline) -- there are zero 'only-in-first' residuals, i.e. nothing the accepted artifact expects is missing from production.
rootCause.provenance: supabase/nonmanaged/destructive-data/2026-08-22_takedown_junk_flags_APPLIED.sql -- a Sky-waived, agent-applied, one-time production-only destructive-data cleanup (applied 2026-08-23) that created these 7 tables as pre-delete backups before removing junk/profanity flag rows ahead of App Store review.
rootCause.confirmedPresentBeforePhase03B: qa-reports/phase03a/2026-09-15-production-preflight/PRODUCTION_CATALOG_CAPTURE.json already lists all 7 bk_2026_08_22_* relation names, captured 2026-09-15 -- five days before the Phase03B production apply (2026-09-20) and the same day the Phase03B staging baseline was banked.
rootCause.whyAbsentFromExpectedArtifact: The Phase03B staging target (cepayqmsoqxshsiyqnvz) is a separate Supabase project that never received the 2026-08-22 production-only destructive-data operation, so it structurally never had and never will have these 7 tables. The 'accepted' staging catalog is therefore correct for staging but was never going to catalog-match production's full object inventory on this specific, known, pre-existing point.
